expression_system: SPR protein source not stated in the SPR subsection. Separate RNA assay protein expressed by baculovirus in Hi-5 insect cells

enzyme_concentration: SPR uses surface immobilization rather than a reported soluble enzyme concentration; 5000-10000 RU immobilization

netarsudil_concentration: SPR: 0.1-100 uM twofold series. VSMC Fig 8F plots 10^-10 through 10^-4 M

buffer: SPR: 1.05x PBS-P plus 5% DMSO. Cellular culture medium composition for the specific dose-response not stated in figure legend
readout: SPR sensorgrams fit to a 1:1 Langmuir equilibrium model; VSMC METTL7B mRNA by qRT-PCR; protein immunoblot; collagen-gel contraction
endpoint_definition: SPR equilibrium binding affinity; cellular half-maximal METTL7B mRNA induction; phenotype endpoints
vehicle_control: Vehicle control explicitly reported for VSMC protein experiment; SPR reference and solvent correction described
no_enzyme_control: Not applicable to cellular expression endpoint; no catalytic no-enzyme control
no_SAM_control: Not applicable because SAM was not part of the netarsudil experiments
dose_response: Yes: SPR 0.1-100 uM; VSMC Fig 8F 10^-10 through 10^-4 M
reported_effect: Binds immobilized METTL7B by SPR and increases METTL7B mRNA/protein-axis readouts in Ang II-stimulated VSMCs; termed agonist/activator
effect_size: VSMC qRT-PCR EC50 0.1 uM (n=5). Fig 8E prints SPR KD 9.53E-03 M (9.53 mM)
kinetic_or_endpoint: Endpoint/equilibrium binding plus cellular endpoints; not enzyme kinetics
interpretation: Operational cellular METTL7B-expression/phenotype activator; no demonstrated catalytic activation
